title: How can I request a CLI?
summary: This document explains how to request a credit limit increase (CLI) on a Rho-Bank credit card: gather current account info, the requested new total limit or increase amount, and a brief reason; submit via secure in-app chat/secure message or the app/website phone number; only the account owner/authorized manager may request. After submission, Rho-Bank sends an email decision within a few business days; if approved the new limit takes effect once processed, and if denied you receive an explanation and timing for another request.
